title: Research dispatcher: money first across themes (value score ranks across themes; theme share breaks ties; programme nodes count as asked)
note: [2026-10-18 lane DISPATCH-MONEY-FIRST-1018] Operator popup ~06:40Z 'Fix now, money first' (runner cap NOT raised, operator declined). MEASURED on run 39098686264 (04:56Z): github_runner 3/3 slots -> RQ-20261017-ae17-08/-09 (regime, 6.5) + ae17-45 (infra, 30.7); RQ-20261017-002 (own_losses, 141.9) and the P1 units deferred 'at capacity'. Cause: fair_order round-robined THEMES by used/weight; value ranked only within a theme. Second cause found: the 17 P1 units carry generated.family programme:P1 and so sorted behind 11 authored c56e units (13..27) inside live_strategy. Rule now: starved first anywhere; then highest value score across themes; theme share breaks EQUAL scores only; inside a theme asked (authored or programme:*) before refill. Replay on the committed queue at 06:5xZ: first 9 picks = P1 units 145.0..64.4. Tests tests/test_research_dispatch_money_first.py (10). theme_share_min_ratio will recover more slowly: threshold left at 0.5 on purpose (comment on the SLO). CLOSES when the first post-merge research-queue-dispatch run's decision lines show the P1 units dispatched ahead of any sub-10-score unit. Decision line: pick=programme:P1. Tests: 6 more in tests/test_research_dispatch_money_first.py (a low-score P1 unit outranks a 4800-score non-P1 unit; list order; reorder/empty the list changes the dispatch; starve guard still first; committed config pinned to [P1, P2]).
